learning_objective: 🎯 We will learn about different types of food, where they come from, and why we need them to grow strong!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Food is like magical fuel for our body! It gives us the amazing energy to play, run fast, learn new things, and grow big and strong.
Hardworking farmers grow grains, fresh fruits, and crunchy vegetables in big green fields. We also get healthy things like milk and eggs from friendly animals!
Some tasty foods like sweet apples and carrots can be washed and eaten raw. Other foods like rice and dal need to be cooked on a fire to make them soft and yummy!

fun_activity.title: 🎨 My Healthy Plate!
fun_activity.instructions: Draw a big round plate on a piece of paper. Use your crayons to fill it with drawings of your favorite healthy fruits and green vegetables!

quick_recap: ⭐ Food gives our body the super energy to work, play, and learn every day.
⭐ We get our daily food from wonderful plants and helpful animals.
⭐ Eating clean, fresh, and healthy food keeps us strong and very happy.
